ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution; approximately 85% high-intensity white pixels vs 15% low-intensity black pixels concentrated in the central notch area and trailing borders.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white regions occupy the majority of both lobes. A centralized, symmetrical low-intensity black region surrounds the median notch. Disconnected black punctate marks are visible on the medial-left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Narrow, acute V-shaped notch with a calculated interior angle of approximately 45 degrees and deep vertical penetration into the fluke body.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Densely packed serrations along the entire trailing edge with variable pixel amplitudes; larger, more irregular peaks are localized toward the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge follows a broad convex curve from notch to tips; distal tips exhibit a sharp concave upward sweep.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of high-intensity circular pixel groups (rosettes) are present at the lateral-most vertices of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct dark, unaligned pixel disruption appearing as a hooked or '7'-shaped mark on the central-left lobe pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Physical indentation at the median notch and concentrated white circular scarring at the distal fluke tips.
other_distinctive_markers: A pair of small, isolated black circular points located on the white field of the left lobe, superior-lateral to the central black pigmentation.
